Staff

News, announcements, service updates and events for staff
Urgent wellbeing support

News

University of Bath achieves 100% success rate for UKRI Proof of Concept awards

The Departments of Life Sciences and Mechanical Engineering have been awarded Proof of Concept 2026 funding from UKRI to support research commercialisation.

University of Bath ranks top in UK and joint second in world for governance in QS World Sustainability Rankings

Ranking recognises University's strong ethical culture, student representation and financial transparency.

Disability History Month 2026

Discover brand new resources developed for 2026 including videos and a podcast, plus there's still time to register for the staff event on 25 November.

Two University of Bath scientists named among the UK's 50 Future Innovators

50 innovators from across the UK were selected to highlight the role universities play in the UK's future.

Environmental and Climate Resilience ‘Themester’ News

The Environmental and Climate Resilience themed semester inspires new cross disciplinary research collaborations

Mathematics at Bath is helping solve cricket’s injury challenges

The England and Wales Cricket Board took part in a five-day workshop at Bath to apply mathematical thinking to some of the biggest challenges within cricket.

Fraud awareness and reporting

The University Counter Fraud Policy provides a mechanism by which people in our University community can report suspected fraud.

Support for students and staff affected by events in the Middle East

The University outlines sources of advice and support.

Support for University of Bath staff affected by international tensions

Details of how we support all our staff whose home region, loved ones, or friends, are currently affected by conflict.

See all news

Events

Volunteer for Campus Pride bulb planting: Tuesday 17 to Friday 20 November
17 Nov 2026 10.00am 10 East, University of Bath

Help to plant a display of 4,000 spring bulbs in rainbow and trans flag colours, representing inclusion and welcome to LGBTQ+ students, staff, and visitors.

CAI seminar: Generalised policy updates: From successor features to behaviour foundation models
25 Nov 2026 1.15pm 1 West 2.104, 1 West, University of Bath

Join André Barreto (DeepMind) to explore multi-task reinforcement learning, policy improvement and behaviour foundation models.

Disability History Month: From Awareness to Action
25 Nov 2026 12.15pm Online

Online event for staff, exploring what it means to embed Disability and neurodivergence inclusion across our University community

CLT EduTalk: TDF - ELandscape 4 Sustainability workshop
2 Dec 2026 12.15pm CB, 5.6, University of Bath

A collaborative, fun and educational workshop discussing the diversity of electronic devices and their environmental and societal challenges

Global Chair public lecture: A Law of Life, from Coordination to Consciousness
2 Dec 2026 4.00pm Chancellors' Building 4.1, The Chancellors' Building, University of Bath

In this public lecture, Professor Scott Kelso discusses his research in complex systems, cognitive science, and neuroscience.

Academic Assembly AMA Session: TRAC Facilities
3 Dec 2026 3.15pm Online

Find out more about the findings and recommendations of the TRAC Facilities Task and Finish Group and put your questions to the panel.

See all events

Service updates

Information on changes to services or infrastructure across the University.

G Car Park Update

From 18 November 2026, new parking regulations will be introduced in G Car Park (Short Stay).

Updates to Visio and Project licensing

If you use Visio or Project, find out about the move to department-funded, per-user licences and the free alternatives available now.

Update to personal printing account top-up

You now need to be connected to the University network to log in and top up your personal printing account in PaperCut.

Read more service updates
